# The Twelve-Factor App Cloud-Native Principles

Twelve-Factor app methodology: codebase, dependencies, config in environment, backing services as resources, stateless processes, concurrency.

## Invariants
- STORE_CONFIGURATION_IN_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES
- STATELESS_SHARE_NOTHING_PROCESSES
- DISPOSABILITY_WITH_FAST_STARTUP_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN
